value.summary: The change refactors the host loop from processing a single turn per step to processing a round of turns, each projected against the same transcript, with the episode state committed once after all turns in the round are durably appended. The pinboard read is correctly bounded by `round_start` to prevent concurrent pin leakage, turn accounting advances by the full round length, and failure handling remains consistent with the per-turn approach. The change looks sound and safe to merge.
